english.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for something that keeps happening without stopping.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when something keeps going without stopping.
Use this for something that keeps happening without stopping, especially when it is tiresome.

examples.english: The continual rain lately makes me not even want to go out.
examples.traditional: 呢排雨不停咁落，搞到我都唔想出街。

examples.english: Those everlasting questions from the kid about when we would arrive were driving me crazy.
examples.traditional: 嗰個細路不停咁問幾時先到，搞到我好煩。
